column2: Snowbound: community meeting called by Bob Walcott, division of tasks (hauling, furnaces, fuel, milk, housekeeping, kitchen, mail, office, messengers)
Bobbie Rondthaler leaves on the 11:40 train (two hours late) for Clemmons and Winston-Salem
